interpretation: This supplementary audit covers model Switch versus the model-selected Stay train with gains exceeding 15 minutes. It is not the narrower raw-policy Stay/model-policy Switch cohort, and it is not proof of gain over the raw-MTA recommended journey. Original counts remain unchanged.
This audit examines only fresh, unique trains actually present in the identical cutoff snapshot, on the unchanged direct Google Stay route and endpoints. No later invented train is admitted.

The best known Stay alternative is a hindsight sensitivity, not a policy that was implemented or available as perfect information. Its endpoints must pass independent confirmed-receipt, exact-identity and 180-second-age checks and actual platform catchability.
Raw prediction catchability is reported separately from actual catchability. A delayed train whose earlier forecast appeared uncatchable can be physically catchable in the proxy reconstruction.
This audit does not promote unknown candidate outcomes to zero, verify literal physical arrival, or repair an impossible selected transfer.

Additional Stay witnesses are not rerun through official alert blocking; a same-cutoff advertised path can conflict with a notice. Such cases are diagnostic witnesses, not new deployable recommendations.
